summary: Backend focused match/geometry regression tests passed (8/8) on public API URL. Frontend mobile web checks validated login/create access, partial manual snap behavior, and tab regressions, but key map-interaction flows (split, deterministic preview/publish assertions) remained inconclusive in automation.

ui_bugs.issue: In controlled manual tap run, first->second tap triggered one /api/routing/snap call, but third tap did not produce a second snap request within wait window (segment count remained 2).
Browser console captured /api/routing/snap HTTP 422 during one run without a visible in-screen error alert captured in that state.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete deterministic end-to-end validation for map-click split and publish no-post-routing assertion due unstable map interaction timing in browser automation; requires manual verification on same build.

issues: DOM overflow probe reported large horizontal overflow (> viewport width), needs manual confirmation against map/tile container behavior.

action_items: Re-verify immediate manual snap per segment with strict wait for route-busy completion before each new tap; ensure second and third segment always issue /api/routing/snap.
Validate split-by-map-click flow in create and preview (including near-end rejection and undo restore) with manual QA and/or improved deterministic map hit scripting.
Re-run publish trace check and assert zero /api/routing/snap and /api/routing/match after successful publish navigation.
Confirm whether 320-width overflow signal is real UI overflow or map tile rendering artifact; fix if real.
critical_code_review_comments: useGpsSnapping.ts correctly enforces 20000ms timer and serial in-flight flush guard; backend match contract aligns with this behavior.
walking_routing.match_points() correctly fail-closes for invalid schema, confidence<0.5, endpoint drift>20m, and >100 samples.
Google map layer still logs deprecation warnings for google.maps.Marker; not blocking now but migration to AdvancedMarkerElement should be planned.
GoogleDoggoMap.tsx reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL fallback instead of EXPO_BACKEND_URL naming from testing guidelines; align env naming to avoid config drift.

success_rate.frontend: 55% (core access/regression ok; key create-map interaction assertions partially inconclusive)

seed_data_creation: No intentional seed creation. UI runs may have left temporary draft state only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser-only validation performed. Physical native GPS behavior NOT tested. Stopped repeated map-selector retries after multiple attempts per loop-prevention rule; next pass should prefer manual assisted verification for map polyline split and deterministic busy-state waits.
rca_of_issue: Most frontend inconclusive points stem from asynchronous map interactions and timing around busy states in web automation. One run showed /api/routing/snap 422 in console; likely point/network eligibility rejection, but visible UI error feedback was not captured in that moment.
